Based on the provided image of the mobile view (390px), here are the answers to your questions:

(1) **Yes.** The **VOICE** and **MUSIC** toggle pills and the **replay button** (circular arrow icon) are clearly visible in the bottom sheet. They are positioned below the main tour text and above the "Narrating..." status line, ensuring they do not overlap with the tour text or the "Next" button.

(2) **Yes.** The status line ("Narrating — music lowers while I speak.") is highly readable. It uses a smaller, grey font that contrasts well with the white background of the sheet, making it easy to distinguish from the primary content.

(3) **No.** There are no visible clipping, overlap, or layout defects within the sheet. All elements—including the progress bar, step counter (1/7), title, subtitle, body text, audio controls, and action buttons—are properly spaced and contained within the sheet's boundaries.

(4) **Partially/Yes.** A portion of the **flowsheet** (showing a circular unit labeled "E-101" connected by an arrow to a rectangular unit) is visible in the background area above the bottom sheet. While the top part of the flowsheet is obscured by the sheet itself, the central diagrammatic elements are clearly visible to provide context for the tour.
